```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(scales)

epa24 <- read_csv("data/processed/epa_clean.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
epa_trends <- read_csv("data/processed/epa_trends_clean.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
msrp_clean <- read_csv("data/processed/msrp_clean.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
msrp_merged <- read_csv("data/processed/msrp_merged.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
ts_clean <- read_csv("data/processed/trimslate_clean.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
recent_df <- read_csv("data/processed/recent_vehicles_2022_2027.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
img_df <- read_csv("data/processed/vehicle_images.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Project Summary

**What Makes a Car Worth Its Price?** investigates how vehicle sticker price (MSRP), engine horsepower, fuel economy, electric driving range, and manufacturer positioning relate to one another—combining verified MSRP benchmarks with recent **2022–2027** vehicle specifications and **50 years (1975–2025)** of U.S. EPA fleet trends.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-dataset-summary

dataset_overview <- tibble(
  Dataset = c(
    "EPA Automotive Trends (MY 2024 Detailed + 1975–2025 Summary)",
    "Original Cars MSRP Dataset (Raw Cleaned / Deduplicated MY 2001–2017)",
    "Trimslate Vehicle Specifications (Full / Recent MY 2022–2027)"
  ),
  `Model Years` = c(
    "1975–2025 & 2024",
    "1990–2017 (2001–2017 MSRP)",
    "1984–2027 (2022–2027 Focus)"
  ),
  `Observations` = c(
    paste0(comma(nrow(epa24) + nrow(epa_trends)), " (", comma(nrow(epa24)), " + ", nrow(epa_trends), ")"),
    paste0(comma(nrow(msrp_clean)), " raw / ", comma(nrow(msrp_merged)), " usable"),
    paste0(comma(nrow(ts_clean)), " total / ", comma(nrow(recent_df)), " recent")
  ),
  `Primary Website Pages` = c(
    "Automotive Trends, Car Explorer",
    "Home, Price & Performance",
    "Car Explorer, Fuel Economy, Price & Performance"
  )
)

kable(dataset_overview)
```

## Data Sources & Citations

1. **U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA)** — *2025 EPA Automotive Trends Report: Explore Automotive Trends Data* (1975–2025 Summary Trends and Model Year 2024 Fuel Economy and Technology Data). U.S. Government work (Public Domain). Available at: <https://www.epa.gov/automotive-trends/explore-automotive-trends-data>
2. **Trimslate** — *The Trimslate Vehicle Specifications Dataset* (52,130 trims across model years 1984–2027, compiled from EPA FuelEconomy.gov, EPA Test Car List, and NHTSA records). Used under **CC BY 4.0** attribution requirements—credit to [Trimslate](https://trimslate.com) (<https://trimslate.com/data>).
3. **Original Cars MSRP Dataset** — Curated vehicle MSRP and engine specifications dataset (`cars_msrp_kaggle.csv`, originally compiled from Edmunds and Kaggle / Cooper Union). Hosted via GitHub Gist (`dvinubius`): <https://gist.github.com/dvinubius/33486dad2dc86319f0a06ffdb1d4f34f>

## Vehicle Photograph Attribution & Licenses

Because `carapi.trustcar.info` was unreachable in DNS at build time, matched recent vehicle photographs on the **[Car Explorer](explorer.qmd)** page were retrieved via [`scripts/download_images.R`](scripts/download_images.R) from **Wikimedia Commons** (the same Creative Commons image repository used by Trimslate). Full photographer and license credits for all **`r nrow(img_df)`** local images are preserved below:

```{r}
#| label: tbl-image-credits

img_credits <- img_df |>
  transmute(
    Vehicle = paste(make, model_prefix),
    `Local File` = paste0("`", local_image, "`"),
    Photographer = photographer,
    License = paste0("[", license, "](", license_url, ")"),
    Source = paste0("[Wikimedia Commons](", source_url, ")")
  )

kable(img_credits)
```
